headline: Consequences of Ukrainians leaving Poland: staff shortages and rising prices
summary: Political statements on deportation and migrant rights in Poland could hurt its economy if Ukrainians leave, economists warn. The report cites staff shortages and rising prices as likely consequences.
why: Poland relies heavily on migrant labour in several sectors, so changes in its workforce affect wage costs, output and inflation.
